purpose: Define deterministic intended-trigger and near-miss non-trigger cases for the four Developer Workflow Kit v1.2 skill candidates. This file is test design only and is not runtime evidence.

skills.name: review-code-with-evidence
intended: Review this pull request diff and tell me whether it is safe to merge.
Find evidence-backed defects in these changed files and give me verification steps.
Can you review this function for correctness and regression risk?
Inspect this patch and prioritize only concrete code-review findings.
non_trigger: Production is returning HTTP 500 after deploy; diagnose the root cause.
Should we choose Kafka or RabbitMQ for this architecture?
Design a reusable AI workflow for triaging support tickets.
Explain what this Java method does without reviewing it.

skills.name: diagnose-bugs-with-evidence
intended: This service started timing out after deploy; diagnose it from these logs and metrics.
Help me debug why this test fails only in CI.
Rank the most likely causes of this exception and tell me what evidence would distinguish them.
Investigate this production incident without guessing a root cause.
non_trigger: Review this pull request for merge blockers.
Compare PostgreSQL and DynamoDB for a new system.
Create an AI workflow contract for incident response.
Refactor this function to be more readable.

skills.name: make-technical-decisions
intended: Compare Postgres and DynamoDB for this workload under these constraints.
Should we use a monolith or microservices for this product given this team and deadline?
Evaluate these deployment platforms and recommend one with reversal triggers.
Help me choose between two implementation approaches without hiding uncertainty.
non_trigger: Debug why this API endpoint returns 500.
Turn our recurring code review process into an AI workflow contract.

skills.name: design-ai-workflows
intended: Turn our recurring PR review process into a reusable AI workflow contract.
Design a governed AI-assisted incident triage workflow for our team.
Standardize this repeated research task with explicit inputs, evidence states, outputs, and fallback behavior.
Create an inspectable operating contract for an AI task that will run repeatedly.
non_trigger: Diagnose this crash from the stack trace.
Should we choose Redis or Memcached?
Write a one-off email explaining our architecture.

execution_rule.intended_case: The named skill should be selected when host/runtime discovery is under test.
execution_rule.non_trigger_case: The named skill should remain inactive when a materially different specialized skill or ordinary response is appropriate.
execution_rule.promotion: No skill may claim SKILL_TRIGGER_EVAL_PASS until these fixtures are executed on a named host/runtime and a receipt is persisted.
